text: Chapter 12: The Weredragons' Vital Point@Weredragon Dispute
Mwana's village has been occupied by the weredragons of\nthe Imperial Dragon faction. Head to his village,\nBoma Konda, to save the villagers!
When you arrived in Boma Konda, Bibia was there. She said\nthere is an underground shelter from which village center is\naccessible too. Go underground through the secret passage!
You saw the Knight of Thorns in the underground shelter.\nHe wants to help beat the minions of the Imperial Dragon.\nFind the way to the center of the village with him!
You saw Brass Dragon Reguita in the village center!\nIt seems to be leading the Imperial Dragon faction.\nDefeat it to liberate the village!
